Rare.name: Advanced Ritual Art
Rare.desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon any 1 Ritual Monster. You must also send Normal Monsters from your Deck to the GY whose total Levels equal the Level of that Ritual Monster.

Rare.name: Bark of Dark Ruler
Rare.desc: If a Fiend-Type monster you control battles, during the Damage Step: Pay LP (in multiples of 100 points), then target the opponent's battling monster; that opponent's monster loses that much ATK and DEF, until the end of this turn.

Rare.name: Dunames Dark Witch
Rare.desc: Even when all odds are against this brave fairy, she will press onwards in battle and never retreat.

Rare.name: Psychic Commander
Rare.desc: When a Psychic-Type monster you control battles, during the Damage Step you can pay Life Points in multiples of 100 (max. 500) to have the monster it's battling lose that much ATK and DEF, until the End Phase.

Rare.name: Swallow Flip
Rare.desc: Negate the activation of an Effect Monster's effect that activates when a monster is Special Summoned (including itself), and destroy it.

Rare.name: The End of Anubis
Rare.desc: While this card is face-up on the field, all effects of Spell, Trap, and Monster Cards that target a card(s) in the Graveyard or that activate in the Graveyard are negated.

Common.name: Amazoness Spellcaster
Common.desc: Target 1 "Amazoness" monster you control and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; switch the original ATK of those targets until the end of this turn.

Common.name: Dark Hole
Common.desc: Destroy all monsters on the field.

Common.name: Gladiator Proving Ground
Common.desc: Add 1 Level 4 or lower "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Key Mace
Common.desc: Enemies' hearts will melt at the sight of this small fairy's cuteness.

Common.name: King of the Skull Servants
Common.desc: The original ATK of this card is the combined number of "King of the Skull Servants" and "Skull Servant" in your GY x 1000. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can banish 1 other "King of the Skull Servants" or 1 "Skull Servant" from your GY; Special Summon this card.

Common.name: Mokey Mokey
Common.desc: An outcast angel. Nobody knows what he is thinking at all. Sometimes he gets mad and that is dreadful.

Common.name: Oscillo Hero
Common.desc: A strange warrior from another dimension.

Common.name: Wattkid
Common.desc: A creature that electrocutes opponents with bolts of lightning.

Common.name: White Hole
Common.desc: When your opponent activates "Dark Hole": Monsters you control cannot be destroyed by that "Dark Hole's" effect.

Super Rare.name: Blackwing - Sirocco the Dawn
Super Rare.desc: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon/Set this card without Tributing. Once per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can target 1 "Blackwing" monster you control; until the end of this turn, it gains ATK equal to the total ATK of all "Blackwing" monsters currently on the field, except itself. Monsters other than the targeted monster cannot attack during the turn you activate this effect.

Super Rare.name: Compulsory Evacuation Device
Super Rare.desc: Target 1 monster on the field; return that target to the hand.

Super Rare.name: Debris Dragon
Super Rare.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 monster with 500 or less ATK in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position, but negate its effects. Cannot be used as Synchro Material, except for the Synchro Summon of a Dragon monster. The other Synchro Material(s) cannot be Level 4.

Super Rare.name: Deep Sea Diva
Super Rare.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower Sea Serpent monster from your Deck.

Ultra Rare.name: Gottoms' Emergency Call
Ultra Rare.desc: If a face-up "X-Saber" monster is on the field: Target 2 "X-Saber" monsters in any Graveyard; Special Summon both to your side of the field.

Ultimate Rare.name: Tragoedia
Ultimate Rare.desc: When you take battle damage: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Gains 600 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand. Once per turn: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls with the same Level the sent monster had in the hand; take control of that face-up monster. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster in your GY; this card's Level becomes the same as that target's, until the end of this turn.
